Both verification steps pass.

## Result

Created `src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/text/ExtendedMessageFormatAgentTest.java` — 30 tests, all green.

```
defects4j compile          → OK (compile + compile.tests)
JUnitCore ...AgentTest     → OK (30 tests)
```

## Approach

- **Style match**: The project uses JUnit 3.8.1 (`junit-3.8.1.jar` in `default.properties`, all sibling tests `extend TestCase`). Mirrored `ExtendedMessageFormatTest`/`CompositeFormatTest`: `extends TestCase`, `(String name)` constructor, `suite()`, `testXxx()` methods, `assertEquals`/`fail()`+try-catch, raw collections, `new Integer(...)`. Runs fine under the JUnit 4.12 `JUnitCore` in `cp.test` via its JUnit-3 compatibility runner.
- **Behavior verified empirically** with `jshell` against the compiled classes before writing assertions (no probe files left behind), so every expected value is real, not guessed.

## Coverage

| Area | Tests |
|---|---|
| Constructors / locale | default vs explicit locale retained (`getLocale()`), null registry ≡ no registry, all 4 constructors exercised |
| No-registry delegation | `toPattern()` + `format()` compared against `java.text.MessageFormat` for plain text, `{0}`, multi-arg, `number`/`choice` subformats (US + Germany locale), escaped quote, quoted braces; plus concrete-value assertions; empty pattern |
| Custom formats | custom format applied, `toPattern()` re-inserts the stripped format descriptions, reused/multiple args, mixed custom + built-in, `getFormats()` returns the custom `Format` instance |
| Registry semantics | unknown name falls through to built-in (matches `MessageFormat`), registry overrides a built-in name, factory receives `name`/`arguments`/`locale` (and `null` style when absent) |
| Escaped quotes (LANG-477) | `''` adjacent to a custom element, escaped quote in literal text around a custom element — asserts both `format()` and `toPattern()` |
| `applyPattern` state | re-apply swaps a custom format back to plain, and plain → custom (observable via `toPattern()` and `format()`) |
| Disabled mutators | `setFormat`, `setFormatByArgumentIndex`, `setFormats`, `setFormatsByArgumentIndex` each throw `UnsupportedOperationException` |
| Error / boundary | unterminated element (with/without registry), non-numeric argument index, unterminated format description, unknown built-in format type, trailing-vs-leading whitespace around the format name, null pattern → `NullPointerException` |
